fields.description: Expired compliance records and records with days to expiry up to this number are marked Critical.
fields.label: Critical Within Days

fields.description: Records with days to expiry up to this number are marked High, after the Critical threshold.
fields.label: High Within Days

fields.description: Records with days to expiry up to this number are marked Medium, after the High threshold. Records beyond this are Low.
fields.label: Medium Within Days
Instructions
fields.options: Priority is calculated from Days to Expiry. Expired, Not Compliant, and Not Paid records remain Critical. Low applies automatically when the record is beyond the Medium threshold.
